content: The frog sitting at the bottom of the deep well believes the sky is only as wide as its mouth.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Jing di zhi wa (井底之蛙) — Zhuangzi (Autumn Floods)
explanation: Confined within the mossy walls of a stone well, the frog is confident that the circular disc of blue overhead constitutes the entire cosmos. Parochial minds confuse their tiny village, dogmatic ideology, or personal experience with the totality of human truth.
practicalInsight: Seek out a viewpoint or philosophy completely foreign to your background today. Listen without the immediate urge to refute.
reflectionPrompt: What narrow 'well' of background, profession, or ideology might be restricting your view of the wider sky?
